summary: Iteration 7 (both) — validated ErrorBoundary + client-error reporting + Logs search + default page-size 10. Backend: added TestClientErrors (POST /api/errors anonymous -> user_email='anonymous'; authenticated -> user_email=<caller>; both discoverable via GET /api/logs) and extended TestLogs (default limit=10, search filters items+total but leaves counts global, case-insensitive). Full suite 37/37 pytest tests pass. Frontend (playwright, 1440x900 on the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL): logged in as admin, POST /api/errors with a UI_TEST_ERR_<hash> marker, opened /logs — logs-range showed '1–10 of 178' (page-size 10 confirmed), logs-next moved to '11–20 of 178' and logs-prev restored; typing the marker into logs-search (debounced) filtered rows to exactly 1 with an 'App Error' red badge (client_error metadata correct); clearing restored the full page; a no-match search returned 0 rows while the 4 stat-cards remained global (178/0/178/0) — proving counts are NOT reduced by the search. Regression navigation across /, /storages, /users, /settings, /files, /logs never rendered the error-screen. Code review of ErrorBoundary.jsx confirms wraps <AppRoutes/> in App.js, componentDidCatch POSTs to /errors with {message,stack,path}, renders ErrorScreen with testids error-screen/error-retry/error-home. No new bugs found for this iteration.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py POST /api/errors: no size or rate-limit on the endpoint — an unauthenticated caller can spam the activity_logs collection indefinitely (only 500-char detail cap). Consider a simple per-IP rate limit or a max total client_error rows.

server.py list_logs: counts are computed with 3 extra count_documents calls per request (all/file/reconnect). Not a bug but noticeable overhead once collections grow — a single aggregation with $facet would be more efficient.

ErrorBoundary.jsx: componentDidCatch fires api.post but does not await/catch the returned promise — silent when the /errors endpoint itself is down. Acceptable (swallow is intentional) but consider a navigator.sendBeacon fallback so errors during unload are still captured.

Logs.jsx: the useEffect debounce (300ms) fires on EVERY dep change including filter/page — not just search — so a tab click still incurs a 300ms delay before data loads. Consider debouncing only the search dep.
Logs.jsx: `total` local variable (line 86) is computed but unused since totalPages already uses data.total — dead code.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests POST several TEST_* client_error markers to /api/errors during the run (they persist as client_error rows in activity_logs — harmless and expected). Frontend test also POSTs one UI_TEST_ERR_<hash> marker. No storages/users created this iteration.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New endpoint POST /api/errors (get_optional_user; body {message,stack,path}) records action='client_error'. GET /api/logs default limit is now 10 (was 25); accepts ?search=<term> which regex-matches user_email/action/storage_name/path/detail case-insensitively; the returned `counts` object stays global (not filtered by search) — only `items`/`total` reflect the filter. Frontend testids: logs-search, error-screen, error-retry, error-home (in addition to prior logs-range/logs-next/logs-prev/logs-filter-*). Logs.jsx uses a 300ms debounced load. `logMeta.js` maps client_error -> label 'App Error', color #dc2626, category 'conn'. Toaster: sonner bottom-right.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found this iteration.
